articles.title: This Robot Rolls Up Like an Armadillo to Save Your Gadgets
articles.summary: Engineers built a robot that curls into a ball when touched, just like an armadillo. It protects fragile electronics inside a hard shell. The whole thing takes about a minute to roll up.

articles.title: See the Harvest Moon Rise with Saturn This Weekend!
articles.summary: The Harvest Moon, the first full moon of autumn, rises on Sept. 26 and 27. Look east after sunset to see it near Saturn. No telescope needed!

articles.title: Scientists Burned Their Own Scrolls to Read Ancient Ones
articles.summary: Researchers burned papyrus scrolls to mimic a 2,000-year-old disaster. They found that lead in ink shows up on X-rays, which could help read charred scrolls from Herculaneum without opening them.
